title: How healers are scored
html:
We turn the boss's damage up until the healer can't keep everyone alive any more. The score is how far it got: 1.20 means the healer still kept up with 20% more damage than real raids took on that boss, and 0.80 means it fell behind at 80% of it.

This counts everything that matters in a fight: how much you heal, how well your heals land where they're needed, and whether your mana lasts.

title: Tank healer and raid healer
html:
Healers do two different jobs, so they're ranked apart.

  • Tank healer: one healer alone on a Protection Warrior tank, for the time a main tank spends on the boss. It fails when the tank dies in more than 1 fight out of 50.
  • Raid healer: two of the same healer on a group of seven mages, through the boss's damage to the raid. It fails when anyone dies in more than 1 fight out of 20. The fight is the length of a real kill.

title: The bosses
html:
Seven bosses, all scored, with the damage real 40-player raids took on them (Warcraft Logs of the Anniversary realms). Forever's own raids have no logs yet, so these Classic bosses stand in.

  • Magmadar (tank 53 sec, raid 54 sec): Fast swings on the tank, with his Frenzy counted as often as real raids let it through, and Lava Breath. His fear, Magma Spit and Lava Bomb are left out.
  • Golemagg the Incinerator (tank 56 sec, raid 56 sec): Golemagg on the tank, with Magma Splash stacking Fire damage on them. The Core Ragers, Earthquake and Pyroblast are left out.
  • Onyxia (tank 35 sec, raid 2 min 17 sec): The ground phases only: the air phase is left out. The raid healer's fight is the whole kill.
  • Broodlord Lashlayer (tank 41 sec, raid 44 sec): Big hits on the tank, and Mortal Strike halves the tank's healing for 5 seconds. Blast Wave hits the melee too.
  • Vaelastrasz the Corrupt (tank 17 sec, raid 31 sec): The most damage of any boss here, in a short fight: Flame Breath stacking on the tank and fire on the whole raid. The tank's fight is one tank's stretch before Burning Adrenaline forces a swap.
  • Chromaggus (tank 1 min 55 sec, raid 1 min 55 sec): Incinerate and Corrosive Acid as his breaths and his Frenzy on the tank, and the Brood Afflictions on the raid. The longest fight here, so mana matters most.
  • Ragnaros (tank 1 min 11 sec, raid 1 min 37 sec): Elemental Fire burns the tank on most of his hits, and the tank's fight is one tank's time between his knockbacks. Real raids tank him in fire resistance gear, which this tank doesn't wear, so he's the hardest boss here.

title: How the sim heals
html:
• Healers react to damage in about 0.3 seconds, a bit faster or slower each time, like a player.
  • A heal that would mostly overheal (more than half) is cancelled before it lands, as a good healer would.
  • A healer picks the biggest rank of a heal that fits the missing health, so it doesn't waste mana.
  • The tables per boss show HPS, overhealing and mana at the boss's normal damage, not at the turned-up damage.

title: The exact math
html:
On each boss, the score is the biggest multiple of the boss's damage at which:

  • Tank healer: the tank dies in no more than 2% of fights.
  • Raid healer: nobody dies in more than 5% of fights.

A healer's score is the average over the seven bosses. The ± next to a number is how far it could move by luck: two healers closer than that are about even.
